changes.text: close the empty left column on Home: move the Contents plate and Coming up beside or under the tube so the first screen is full
phone: a larger Send key and a bigger composer; on Ideas, the filters as one compact row of keys instead of a tall column
desktop: row text one size up, keep the amber 'was due N days ago', and add a fine lit track line down the To do rows
give Home's first screen a visible structural change: a track running from the head to the box, or the tube standing on a grid floor
make the scanlines on the key word visible at half size (a coarser period), keep the glow on live things only
overdue tasks read 'was due N days ago' in amber, the Add key wide and primary, and the keycap tray carried to To do and Plans filters
Thread hung on a rail from Vera's mark, times in the margin, a lit ring at the box; drop the 'Vera asks' opener and tighten the gaps beside short lines
lit-square checkboxes with a standard tick inside the frame; selects get a full border and a caret; nav chips and the phone tab bar reach 44px
keep the giant lit question but cap it at two lines on the phone so the box starts higher, and brighten MIND toward #6dff9c
swap the warm cream for a cooler, greener bone, and the brass for a cool steel, so no warm plates remain
cut the extra corner ticks and the empty hatched panels beside the setup cards; thin the card outlines so the lattice is calmer
Status headline and its deck on one baseline; make the Home poster question a little calmer (less white) so the lit rail and the NOW node carry the glow
raise every small target (nav chips, tags, lamps) to 44px
